/lo ma gyon ma'i gzungs chog shin tu zab pa bzhugs so/ /

tei:div.tei:p: /lo ma gyon ma'i gzungs chog shin tu zab pa bzhugs so//

bla ma dang lhag pa'i lha la phyag 'tshal lo// 'dir dbang thob cing dam tshig la gnas pa'i sngags pas nad yams la sogs kyi nyer 'tshe zhi bar bya ba'i phyir ri khrod lo ma gyon ma'i gzungs sgrub bya bar spro na/ gnas yid dang mthun par maṇ+ḍal mda' gang la sogs pa'i lte bar rdul tshon nam/ 'bru'i dkyil 'khor sgo bzhi pa'am gcig pa shar du lta ba'i dbus su pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad mdzes tshon/ lte ba dkar po byas pa'i lte bar nas bre gang tsam spungs/ 'dab ma brgyad la nas kyi tshom bu re re byas/ dbus su rin po che'i bum pa gu gul gyis bdug /yungs kar gyis brab/ mgul chings ze prog lnga pa/ nang du rgyun 'bab kyi chu dang gser/ dngul/ zangs/ byu ru/ mu tig /sbrang rtsi/ bu ram/ ka ra/ zho/ 'o ma/ mar/ nas/ 'bras/ so ba/ til/ gro/ tsi tsi/ gur gum/ cu gang*/ sug smel/ ka ko la/ li shi/ tsan+dan/ a ga ru/ ba lu'am/ shug pa sogs shing 'bras bu can gyis kha brgyan pa'i gseb tu/ rab gnas dang ldan pa'i rdo rje la gzung thag za 'og bal tshon lnga bsgril pa/ rang gi lus tshad sum 'gyur yod par btags/ dkar gtor bzhi dang mchod pa lnga sogs bshams/ rdor dril 'du byas/ bshang gci dor/ khrus dang gtsang sbra la gnas shing kha shar du phyogs pa'i stan bde bar bsam gtan gyi yan lag lnga la gnas pas skyabs sems sngon du btang nas/ sngon 'gro'i gtor ma dang*/ mchod pa byin brlabs/ tshogs zhing spyan 'dren/ mchod bstod/ yan lag bdun pa byas nas rang la bstim pa rnams spyi 'gro ltar byas/ rang yi dam gang mos su bsgoms/ bzlas pa phreng skor gcig tsam bya/ bum pa swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las/ bh+rūṃ las byung pa'i rin po che'i bum pa yangs shing rgya che ba phyi bum pa la nang lha'i gzhal yas khang mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa bdud rtsi'i rgya mtshos gang ba'i dbus su/ paṃ las sna tshogs pad+ma'i steng du a las zla ba'i gdan la paṃ ser po las 'od 'phros/

'phags pa mchod/ slar 'od zer mtsho la rde'u bskyur ba'i gnyer ma je cher 'gro ba ltar thog mar bdag 'khor bcas/ de rjes rang gi yul grong*/ mthar khams gsum gyi sems can thams cad kyi las dang nyon mongs shes sgrib 'go nad yams rims la sogs pas gtso byas mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad zhi zhing dag par byas nas par+ṇa sha wa ri'i skur bsgyur/ 'od zer tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las par+ṇa sha wa ri dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi yum du gyur pa/ rtsa zhal dzam+bu nā da'i kha dog lta bu dang*/ zhal g.yas sngo/ g.yon dkar ba/ phyag drug g.yas dang po'i rdo rje/ gnyis pas dgra sta/ gsum pas mda'/ g.yon pa dang pos sdigs mdzub dang bcas pa'i zhags pa/ gnyis pas shing lo'i bam po/ gsum pas gzhu bsnams pa/ rin po che sna tshogs pa'i dbu rgyan/ snyan rgyan/ mgul rgyan/ se mo do/ do shal/ ska rags/ phyag gdub/ zhabs gdub/ sor gdub la sogs 'od 'phro bas mdzes pa| dar sna tshogs kyi stod g.yogs dang smad g.yogs can/ ri khrod kyi shing lo gyon pa cung zad khro ba'i rnam 'gyur can/ dbu skra thor tshugs su bcings pa/ zhabs gnyis brkyang bskum me dpung 'bar ba'i klong na bzhugs pa'i thugs kar paṃ las pad+ma dang zla ba'i dbus su paṃ yig ser po gnas pa las 'od 'phros pas 'og min nam rang bzhin gyi gnas nas par+ṇa sha wa ri ye shes pa badz+ra sa ma ya dzaḥ oṃ par+ṇa sha wa ri a ti pū hoḥ pra tīts+tsha hoḥ oṃ par+ṇa sha wa ri ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ shapada'i bar gyis mchod/ dzaḥmadun gyi ye shes pa bum nang gi lha tshogs phyi rol du spyan drangs/ hūm̐ dam tshig pa la thim/ baṃ gnyis su med par gyur/ hoḥshin tu dgyes par gyur/ slar bum pa'i lha spyi bor oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par āḥdamar po/ thugs kar hūm̐ sngon pos mtshan pas sku gsung thugs byin gyis brlabs/ slar yang rang dang bum nang gi lha'i thugs ka'i sa bon gyi 'od kyis phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba 'khor bcas dbang gi lha tshogs rnams mdun gyi nam mkhar spyan drangs/

oṃ pañca ku la sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ shapada'i bar gyis mchod/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣiñca tu māṃ/ zhes gsol ba btab pas dbang gi lhas/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shrī ye hūm̐/ zhes pa'i chus bum dbang gi lhas par+ṇa sha wa ri'i spyi bo nas dbang bskur/ sku gang dri ma dag chu'i lhag ma gyen du 'khyil ba las don yod grub pa gtso bor gyur pa'i rigs lngas dbu brgyan/ mdun gyi nam mkhar bzhugs pa'i dbang gi lha sangs rgyas byang sems rnams kyang mi gshegs par par+ṇa sha wa ri'i rnam par gyur nas sprin dkrigs pa ltar bzhugs par bsam/ oṃ par+ṇa sha wa ri sarba ta thā ga ta sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ shapada'i bar gyis mchod/ gtor ma bzhi po spyi 'gro ltar byin gyis brlabs/ dang po/ oṃ gu ru rat+na tra yā ya i maṃ ba ling kha kha khā hi khā hi/ gsum gyis bla ma dang dkon mchog gsum la dbul/ bdag dang mtha' yas pa'i sems can tshogs gnyis rdzogs sgrib gnyis byang nas rnam mkhyen go 'phang thob par byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ zhes dang*/ gnyis pa/ oṃ par+ṇa sha wa ri sa pa ri wā ra i maṃ ba ling kha kha khā hi khā hi/ bdag dang sems can rnams la 'tshe ba'i sgrib gsum nyes tshogs 'go nad yams rims la sogs pa mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad zhi zhing bsrung du gsol/ zhes dang*/ gsum pa/ oṃ dharma pā la sa pa ri wā ra i maṃ ba ling kha kha khā hi khā hi/ bdag dang sems can rnams chos dbyings byang chub sgrub pa la bar du gcod pa'i 'tshe ba rnams mi 'byung zhing bsrung bar mdzad du gsol/ zhes dang*/ bzhi pa/ oṃ de sha i maṃ de wa sa pa ri wā ra na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta a wa lo ki te oṃ saṃ bha ra saṃ bha ra hūm̐/ kha 'bar ma'i sngags gsum gyis phul nas bar gcod mi byed par bka' bsgo byas/ gtor ma phyir bskyal/ de nas rdor dril dang bcas bstod pa ni|

chos sku bde ba chen po'i dkyil 'khor nas// yams la sogs pa nad kyi 'jigs pa dang*// dus min 'chi las skyob par byed pa yi// dngos grub phrin las yum la phyag 'tshal lo| |pad+ma'i gdan la gser mdog ri khrod ma// rtsa ba'i zhal ser g.yas sngo g.yon dang dkar// dbu skra thor tshugs gzi brjid ldan pa yi// dngos grub lha mo'i sku la phyag 'tshal bstod| |ye shes thugs rje'i bdag nyid bcom ldan 'das// dus mtha'i me dpung 'bar ba'i klong dkyil nas// zhal gsum phyag drug 'jigs byed khro mo'i zhal// zhabs gnyis brkyang bskum mdzad la phyag 'tshal bstod// ri khrod lo ma sku la mnabs pa yi// mda' gzhu dgra sta shing lo'i bam po 'dzin// sdigs mdzub rdo rje bsnams pa'i sha wa ri// yum chen 'gro ba'i mgon la phyag 'tshal bstod// ces bstod/ sngags bzla ba'i gzung thag gi sne mo nas bzung ste/ rang yi dam du gsal ba'i thugs ka nas 'od 'phros pa/ bum nang gi lha mo'i thug kar phog pas sdig sgrib nad yams sogs sbyong bar zhal gyis bzhes pa'i thugs dam bskul/ thugs gnyis med ye shes bdud rtsi'i ngo bo dkar nar gyis bab pas bum pa khengs/ rang dang bum nang gi lha'i thugs ka'i sa bon las 'od 'phros pas/ mdun gyi nam mkhar bzhugs pa'i sha wa ri rnams la phog /gong ltar dmigs pa byas nas/ oṃ pi sha tsi par+ṇa sha wa ri sarba ma ri pra sha ma ṇi hūm̐/ zhes ci mang bzlas/ sngags phreng yang gzung thag brgyud bum par song nas ngo bo sngags kyi rnam pa bdud rtsir song bar bsam/ thun bar du mchod bstod gtor 'bul bstod pa gong ltar bya/ sngags 'di phal cher du sarba dz+wa ra zhes 'byung mod/ mgon po 'bri gung pa'i bka' 'bum du sha wa ri'i sgrub thabs gnyis kar 'di kho na ltar 'byung bas mang chu ma bsnyeg par 'di kho na ltar bris pa yin/ mthar mchod cing gtor ma 'bul/ bstod nas yi ge brgya pa gsum gyis bzod par gsol nas/

bum nang kyi mdun gyi nam mkha'i sha wa ri rnams bdud rtsir zhu bas bum pa khengs par bsam/ khrus ni/ thog mar bla ma dkon mchog gi rten la/ ji ltar bltams pa sogs rol mo'i sgra dang bcas sku khrus gsol/ de nas yi dam dang chos skyong gi rten la khrus gsol/ de nas yul lha gzhi bdag rnams la khrus bya/ de nas rang dang yon bdag nad pa sogs la khrus bya/ dgos pa thams cad sngags bzla zhing khrus bya'o// mjug tu yig brgya dang dge rtsa bsngo/ shis brjod bya/ las kyi rjes mi mngon par bya'o// de yang bla ma rin po ches rnal 'byor pa bzhi'am/ brgyad dam/ bcu gnyis sam bcu drug la sogs pas tshul bzhin nyams su blangs pas gnod pa thams cad zhi bar 'gyur ba ni myong bas grub pa yin te/ me'i ting nge 'dzin la gnas nas gnod byed sreg pa dang*/ mtshon chas dum bu byed pa dang*/ rdung ba dang rdeg pa la sogs ting nge 'dzin ni bya mi rung ba kho na'o// zhes gsungs so// 'di'i rjes gnang ni kho bos bgyis pa'i sgrub thabs nor bu'i phreng ba ltar bya'o// 'di la yi dam du bgyi ba dag gi bya tshul ni/ zhal rgyun ltar bya'o// de ltar sha wa ri'i gzungs chog 'di'ang mnga' ris lha mo dkon mchog lhun grub kyis bskul ngor/ mgon po 'bri gung pa chen po'i bka' 'bum kyi gzungs sgrub la bcos lhad med par ngag bsgrigs su/ 'bri gung pa chos kyi grags pas bris pa 'dis sems can thams cad la phan par gyur cig/ //shu bhaṃ//
